sources.title: wangzhang/GLM-4.7-Flash-abliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An uncensored version of zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash with safety refusal behavior removed via abliteration. The model retains its original capabilities (KL divergence: 0.0065) while reducing refusals from 52/100 to 9/100 ...

sources.snippet: GLM-4.7-Flash-abliterated is a refusal-ablated build of GLM-4.7-Flash, released by huihui-ai, available in Transformers, GGUF (imatrix) and MLX, mit licence.
